=== Lead photograph (30 Oct 2026) ===
The lead is a crop of a Facebook photograph posted 26 April 2024. The Facebook photo viewer names John Petelle. Identification: distinctive name plus Gold 45 FL on the Decipher Squadron roster (Lincoln, NE). The Facebook profile is facebook.com/JohnPetelle, a member of the Star Wars CCG Facebook group. The profile lists Lives Lincoln, Nebraska and From Palmyra, Nebraska. Bill locked the match on 30 October 2026: group membership plus exact hometown plus tabletop RPG hobby. The uncropped original is a solo indoor selfie. Wiki File is the dest JPEG of the photograph. The File page Preserved copy is the Facebook photo-viewer screenshot. Identification stays on Talk. See [[:File:John Petelle portrait.jpg]] and [[:File:John Petelle Facebook portrait.jpg]].
